        12                  REVEREND YOUNG:    Thank you,

        13       Senator.

        14                  As we share the prayer today, may

        15       we take a glance at the beautiful stained

        16       glass behind the podium.  It's the state seal

        17       that has the motto "Excelsior," "ever upward,"

        18       and it replaced the crown, the place of the

        19       crown in 1777.  Lady Liberty with peasant cap,

        20       representing the democracy rule, has her left

        21       foot stepping on the crown, representing the

        22       rejection of royalty.

        23                  As citizens of the Empire State, we

        24       have been the leader with our constitution

        25       12 years before the federal Constitution.  As

         5                  ACTING PRESIDENT GALLIVAN:

         6       Senator Klein to explain his vote.

         7                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Thank you,

         8       Mr. President.

         9                  This legislation expands the

        10       definition of the crime of forgery in the

        11       second degree to include insurance documents.

        12                  One of the problems we've been

        13       seeing that continues to grow is the

        14       proliferation of insurance fraud.  This

        15       legislation will provide an additional tool to

        16       our law enforcement officers to combat auto

        17       insurance fraud, which of course hurts honest

        18       people who do pay their insurance and do have

        19       insurance as required in New York State to

        20       register your motor vehicle.

        21                  I vote yes, Mr. President.
